result.summary:
CODE-DESIGNER, WF-02 step 1, round 2 (rework after both CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR FAILs). Design version 2: docs/design/REQ-001-pixel-office.md - 2888 lines, 34 tables, 145 test-catalog rows in six files (HK, SV, PG, ST, LY, OF) plus the shared helper tools/test/pixel-office-helpers.js, 44 mutants, probes P0-P20 with command and output in Appendix A, no implementation code. It is the only project file written; docs/requirements.yaml is untouched (sha256 de702d19..., as validated); probes ran in the session scratchpad. CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR has NOT checked version 2 yet.

EVERY FINDING IS CLOSED (result.changes has one entry per id): C1, C4-C10, the three hardening proposals of the REQ-001 validator, F1-F6 and N1-N10 in the first pass; C2 and C3 at the end, after the amended requirement passed (REQ-VALIDATOR round 5, PASS: step-00b-req-validator-r5.json); plus that validator's H2, H3 and O1, and H1 of round 4.

C2 / C3 / H2 / O1, ALIGNED TO THE AMENDED TEXT (criterion 6(г) and both «Что меняется в проекте» lists)
- Section 4.2: the 'extension, to be confirmed' box is replaced by the criterion's own wording and four consequences. A main-session row with no end of answer is closed as 'окончание не записано' by the next request of the same session, a session end after its start, or, if neither, a server start after it (journal_lines > i, by line number, not by time). A row closed only by a server start stays open for the end of the answer: a later Stop of the same session makes it 'завершена'; a Stop without an open row changes nothing. README limitation 7 (section 9.4) now follows the requirement's «Сбои» sentence; section 3.5 and the hook table are aligned; D9 is marked as accepted by the requirement text (no decisions/ entry needed).
- PG-12d6 is its own catalog row with eight cases: (1) the criterion's named scenario (request -> server start -> 'окончание не записано' -> end of answer -> 'завершена'); (2) H2: a server start counted regardless of order (the server's own start is always recorded, so a live turn would show 'окончание не записано' from its first second): a start before the request leaves the row in progress, also with two starts and with the request clock 30 s behind; (3) H2: a Stop matched across sessions; (4)-(8) next request, session end and resume, second Stop, untrusted lines, stale start record. Mutants M41-M44 added (M41 any start anywhere in the journal, M42 Stop of any session, M43 a server start closes for good, M44 a late Stop reopens rows already closed by a next request or a session end); M18 now also names PG-12d6 (2). Probe P20 (command and output in Appendix A) runs the rule on these cases and on the wrong readings: each wrong reading differs from the rule on the cases named for it; the named scenario alone catches only M43.
- C3: tools/test/pixel-office-helpers.js is an official new file named in both lists; sections 10 (intro), 10.1, 13 (item 1) and 14 (intro, TEST-DESIGNER row) say so. Section 10.1 explains the name without .test.js (npm test = node --test "test/**/*.test.js"; P20, second command: the glob runs 1 test and not the helper, a bare node --test would run it, exit 1) and what covers the file (prettier, eslint, the skip/todo/directive greps over tools/test, the AC14 pins unchanged - REQ-VALIDATOR round 5).
- Hashes: section 0 and section 11 Q1 now cite the amended blocks with the status line restored to pending - REQ-001 530b1c3b13d58598ebb77ef50e60e42bb518654650423d7b20b39fdc416d4e21, REQ-007 d842c5983085e38796e939fb6af7dc0bad5fa4225772fe96070377e578f1ead5 - recomputed by me twice (at the start of the alignment and just before filling this handoff) with the validator's awk + sed + shasum method; they equal the validator's values and replace d0641025... / b0a739b4....
- O1: section 4.5 kept (the main character works while a main-session row is open; a row closed as 'окончание не записано' is not work); explanation added, main-character cases added to OF-05 so the rule has a test, note in section 13 item 2. H3: no change needed (PG-14, PG-14b, PG-14c, PG-14d already carry it).

CONSISTENCY AUDIT (script over the file, run last): 34 tables well-formed; every test ID referenced in sections 7, 8, 10.3, 10.6, 11 exists in the catalog and every catalog test is referenced; the 44 mutants are numbered 1..44 and name existing tests; no placeholders; the old markers ('на подтверждение', 'отложено', 'вопрос 1 раздела 13', 'будут выровнены', d0641025/b0a739b4 as current) are gone; section 10.3 still maps all 14 criteria of REQ-001 and all 8 of REQ-007 (the named scenario of 6(г) is mapped to PG-12d6 case 1); the grep for code constructs outside tables finds none.

FOR ORCH: (1) after the design passes, write the decision record from section 12: D1-D8 and D10-D14 (D9 is now in the requirement; D11-D14 are new in version 2); (2) DOC-UPDATER takes the 7 anti-pattern proposals in section 11 Q13; (3) section 13 item 14 asks ORCH to confirm that the office parts of app.js, index.html, texts.js and style.css count as 'файлы офиса' (no gate effect); optional: one clause in REQ-007 criterion 2 for O1 (the design does not depend on it). The run was interrupted by an API limit twice; every edit was saved stepwise and nothing was written to this handoff before completion.
changes: C1 [blocking] - sections 2.3 (App), 4.6, 8.3 (E26, E26b), 10.1-10.3, 10.6 (M31, M32), 12 (D12), 13 (item 13), App. A P11. Poll protocol written down: one request in flight (a tick is skipped while one is pending), a 3 s AbortController timeout counted as a failure, a response applied only if from === 0 (replace) or from === entries.length (append), otherwise discarded and re-polled with after = entries.length, immediate poll when the tab becomes visible. New tests PG-14b (fetch never settles), PG-14c (wrong from ignored, no duplicates), PG-14d (visibility). Re-measured in P11: a SIGSTOPped server - curl connected in 0.0003 s and timed out after 3.009 s (exit 28); fetch with AbortController rejected after 3007 ms; plain fetch was still pending after 6 s and settled only after SIGCONT.

C2 [blocking, done after the requirement amendment] - sections 3.5, 4.2, 9.4 (item 7), 10.2 (PG-12d1-d5, PG-12d6), 10.3 (row 6), 10.6 (M18, M41-M44), 11 (Q1, Q12), 12 (D9), 13 (items 1-2), hook table in 1.1, App. A P20. Aligned exactly to the amended criterion 6(г): the 'extension, to be confirmed' box is replaced by a citation of the criterion and four consequences; the row is closed only by a next request of the same session, a session end after its start, or a server start after its start (journal_lines > i, by line number, not by time); a row closed only by a server start stays open for the end of the answer - a later Stop of the same session gives 'завершена' (closed_by 'stop'); a Stop without an open row changes nothing. README limitation 7 follows the requirement's «Сбои» sentence. D9 is accepted by the requirement text, no decisions/ entry. PG-12d6 rewritten as eight cases, case 1 = the criterion's named scenario. Verified by probe P20.

C3 [blocking, done after the requirement amendment] - sections 10 (intro), 10.1, 13 (item 1), 14 (intro, TEST-DESIGNER row), App. A P20. tools/test/pixel-office-helpers.js is an official new file named in both «Что меняется в проекте» lists (round-5 text); 'needs ORCH confirmation' removed. Section 10.1 gives the reason for the name without .test.js and what covers the file. Re-measured in P20 (second command): node --test "test/**/*.test.js" runs 1 test, exit 0, and does not run a helper with a failing top-level test; a bare node --test runs it (exit 1).

C4 - sections 3.5, 4.7, 10.2 (PG-12d7, PG-23). MainRow.key = 'main:' + start_index (unique and stable between recomputations and loads); a table 'event kind -> role / description' for the journal row; data-key defined from Task.key and MainRow.key.

C5 - sections 3.1, 3.4, 4.2, 8.3 (E33), 9.4, 10.2 (PG-12c7), 10.6 (M37), 12 (D14). A server-start record whose journal_lines exceeds the number of lines in the same response is ignored (trace of a deleted or truncated journal); README says to delete both files together (limitation 11); test PG-12c7; decision D14.

C6 - sections 8.2 (E12), 10.1, 10.2 (SV-11b-e), App. A P14. The busy-port probe (1 s GET) is tested with four occupant kinds: silent socket, closes before replying, HTTP with text, JSON without app and with another app; behaviour measured in P14 (the real Pixel Office answer is the control).

C7 - sections 2.2, 5.2, 8.2 (E31), 10.2 (SV-44), App. A P13. JournalReadError -> 500 {"error":"read_failed"} with the server alive; test with an unreadable events.jsonl and with a directory in its place; what starts() does on an OS read error is stated (AP-014 class rule); OS error codes measured in P13.

C8 - sections 2.2, 10.2 (HK-16), App. A P12. The HMAC key is the 43-character secret string as UTF-8 (not base64-decoded), the signature is lowercase hex; a known-answer vector (fictional secret and body) added to HK-16; Node and openssl give the same value in P12.

C9 - sections 1.2, 1.8, 3.1, 3.5, 4.1, 4.2, 6.2, 9.1, 9.4, 10.4, 14, App. A P18. (i) section 1.2 wording identical to 4.2(з); (ii) Task.session_id = session of the last SubagentStart, test PG-12c8; (iii) the assumption 'the computer clock is never set backwards' and the hidden-tab limitation written into 4.1 and README; (iv) --dir without SAI_PIXEL_OFFICE_DIR: warning at start, README, test SV-45; (v) the eslint block moved to the REQ-001 page row and the step order fixed (section 14); (vi) PROMPT with run_in_background true and 'exactly two' UserPromptSubmit/Stop, measured on 2.1.286 in P18.

Ruling on open question 12: the file stays in public/ with the validator's conditions (Node-only CLI exempt from the 'pure module' rule but under AP-014 and Q10; not referenced by index.html or browser modules - OF-12, PG-20; OF-13 checks the journal sha256 is unchanged).

F2 [high] - sections 2.3, 3.6, 4.5, 10.2 (OF-06, OF-15, OF-18), 10.6 (M33, M39). Sim.sync defined: adds missing characters at their seats, drops vanished ones, re-seats only a character with no queue and a changed desk, never touches a walking or queued one; routes sorted by event_index (tie: handoff before result); read-only accessors App.getOffice() and App.getSim(); new test OF-18 (a walker mid-route survives a poll with unrelated events); OF-15 observes through getSim().

F3 [medium] - sections 2.3, 3.6, 4.5, 10.2 (OF-19), 10.6 (M34), 12 (D13), App. A P15. Label rule roleLabel (text of the last parentheses, else the name; at most 16 code points, ellipsis), fillText with maxWidth, full name only in legend and card. Measured in Chrome 154 on the 23 real role names plus the built-in types: old rule - 13 of 26 labels wider than the 144 px desk spacing; new rule - maximum 98 px, none wider than 130 px, none beyond the canvas; effect of maxWidth measured by getImageData.

F4 [medium] - sections 2.3, 3.5-3.7, 4.5, 4.7, 10.2 (LY-05, OF-20). Classes and data-* for legend items and card parts; complete texts.js; click path (canvasPoint conversion with getBoundingClientRect, hit box around the cell centre, nearest wins, tie -> smaller desk_index); drawing contract (CELL_COLORS exported, one fillRect(x*CELL, y*CELL, CELL, CELL) per cell before monitors and characters); DESKS.cell defined; MainRow.end_index added and Card.recent_completed sorted by it; new test OF-20.

F5 [medium] - sections 13 (item 14), 14. Step order: layout and office-* before app.js (every step ends with a green check); the eslint block moved to the REQ-001 page row; the office parts of app.js, index.html, texts.js and style.css named in the REQ-007 row; ORCH is asked (item 14) to confirm they count as 'файлы офиса' (no gate effect, all paths are inside the declared write set).

F6 [medium] - sections 4.5, 4.7 (data-drawn), 5.4, 10.2 (SV-18, PG-20, OF-21), 10.3, 10.4 (U3, order with U1(и) and U1(ж)), 10.6 (M35), App. A P17. Step U3 recipe (Chrome in the background, poll the dump for '</html>', kill the process group, fail after 30 s, 'не выполнено' only if Chrome is absent); conditions: no CONSOLE line, task, badge, canvas, and data-drawn (the number of drawn characters, set only after drawOffice completed; U3 requires a positive number); U3 runs between U1(и) and U1(ж); mapped in 10.3 to REQ-001 criteria 8 and 9 and REQ-007 criterion 6; SV-18 and PG-20 check no <style> element and type=module on every <script>. Tested on stand-in pages in P17: the good page passes; broken-draw, classic script, <style> element and closed port fail as intended; no Chrome process is left.

N1 - sections 3.5, 4.2, 4.5. Task.stop_indices added (numbers of the trusted SubagentStop lines after the first start, in order; end_index is the last), so routes do not rescan or re-apply the trust filter.

N2 - sections 3.6, 4.5, 10.2 (OF-06, OF-18). A route 'result' waits for the 'handoff' of the same task (field after = id of the handoff; routes ordered by event_index), so a foreground launch (linking PostToolUse after the stop) no longer plays both at once.
N3 - sections 3.7, 10.6 (M29). The events of a role card are only lines with agent_id; main-thread lines of a --agent session never land on a role card.

N4 - sections 2.3, 3.6, 4.4, 4.5, 10.2 (OF-03, LY-02, LY-06-LY-08), 12 (D11), App. A P16. 28 desks (27 x 24 grid, 7 rows) with buildOffice(model, desks); the requirement's 'not fewer than 24' and the 24-desk overflow test are kept through the desks parameter. Grid verified in P16: 756 ordered desk pairs, longest path 37 cells, 0 off-walkable samples.

N5 - sections 10.2 (OF-08), 10.6 (M11, M25-M30). M11 no longer lists LY-02; OF-08 checks cell kinds through cellKind/MAP, not walkable; mutants added for criteria 1, 2, 3 and 5 (unrecorded counted as work, a marked line used by the office, a route without the launcher, desks by name, card with untrusted events, page sends POST).

N7 - sections 4.5, 10.2 (PG-20, PG-22, OF-01), 10.6 (M38).
